name: Seachem Alkaline Buffer
description: Non-phosphate carbonate buffer that raises KH and pH toward the alkaline range. Manufacturer dosing is tuned to a target pH (and pairs with Acid Buffer to hit a setpoint), so a fixed per-gram delta is NOT disclosed.
notes: Use with Acid Buffer to dial a precise pH; the two together set the buffering window. Raises KH — not for soft-water (Caridina) tanks.
